items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: the guy that was making all the arrangements was Nathan Van Cleve... He was playing trumpet in the band... Bill King was the bass player.

ctx.x: Do you remember who was in that band, that first band?

Yeah. Well, the guy that was making all the arrangements was Nathan Van Cleve, who later became quite a big heavy in the studios here, out in the West Coast, arranging. He was playing trumpet in the band. Johnny Dillard, Bob Kuzamano, and Doug Shoffner. That was the trumpet section. And the trombone player was Wally Baron. Let's see, Billy Speer was the baritone saxophone player, and Stu -- Stu, Stu, Stu, come on Stu, where are you -- Stu something was the tenor, and -- I've got a couple of blank faces there.…
I remembered more of those than I thought I was going to.
